summary: Triton International Ltd filed a routine Form -6K, the US equivalent of a domestic quarterly current report, furnishing its September 30, 2026 interim financial statements covering the three- and nine-month periods. The exhibit consists almost entirely of XBRL tagging data — balance sheet, income statement, equity roll-forward and segment line items — with no transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation or advisor disclosed. No corporate action, ownership change or structural event appears in the excerpt. What to watch: nothing deal-related; treat as an ordinary periodic disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
